## Notes (extraction)
- The page is not linked from the site navigation. Its entire content consists of the two headings; there are no credentials, procedures, fields, or examples.
- EN, RU and UZ agree. RU translates the headings to “Аутентификация” and “Базовая авторизация”; UZ retains the English headings. All three requested URLs return HTTP 200.
